title: SinglePlayer Enhanced
body:
Enhance your singleplayer vanilla experience!

# Crazy High Renderdistance
The render distance is done by the LoD Mod [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy). Not all Shaders are supported (the included ones are).

# World Generation
The World Generation is done by [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith). It provides a near Vanilla World just scaled up to have more realistic and extreme Landscapes.

# Optimization Mods
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
- [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
- [Ferrite Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
- [Fast Ip Ping](https://modrinth.com/mod/fast-ip-ping)
- [FastQuit](https://modrinth.com/mod/fastquit)
- [Lazy Language Loader](https://modrinth.com/mod/lazy-language-loader)
- [Fadeless](https://modrinth.com/mod/fadeless)

# Shaders
Shaders are supported as [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) is included.
These Shaders are pre-installed:
- [BSL Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders)
- [Bliss Shader](https://github.com/X0nk/Bliss-Shader/tree/Unstable)
